This directory contains a deliberately minimal vendored subset of
EURAC-EEBgroup/pyBuildingEnergy for an isolated Cloudflare Workers
compatibility proof of concept.

Upstream repository: https://github.com/EURAC-EEBgroup/pyBuildingEnergy
Upstream package version inspected: 2.0.3

No claim is made that this subset implements MC001-2022. LaCurent keeps

The vendored source is intentionally unmodified in this PoC so comparison
against upstream remains auditable.
